cohort: 183 women with twin pregnancies (29 adolescents and 154 controls)
finding: While obstetric and perinatal outcomes for twin pregnancies in teenagers were broadly similar compared to controls, the risk of extreme preterm birth was increased in the adolescent group after controlling for confounders.
mod_finding: Adolescent girls were less likely to delivery via an elective caesarean section compared to women in the control group.
